item.title: New York mother jailed for kidnapping her child wins fresh hearing over $500 child-support cap
item.description: A New York woman serving a seven-year prison sentence for kidnapping her child has won a fresh hearing over unpaid child support. Chelsea Four-Rosenbaum had sought to limit her debt to $500, arguing that her income remained below federal poverty guidelines while imprisoned. An appeals court ruled that her request had been examined under the wrong legal provision and ordered a fresh review.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Kentucky appeals court overturns ruling favouring husband in $703,000 farm dispute
item.description: Mary and Fred Holden's property settlement agreed to equal ownership of their Kentucky farm. Disagreements arose regarding when the farm should be listed for sale after two years. After their son moved out, Mary requested the farm be sold or purchased by Fred. The appeals court found the agreement's wording ambiguous, requiring a fresh evaluation in family court.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Renovate California Beachfront Home: Planning shows Kutcher, Kunis expand retreat; cottage to go
item.description: Ashton Kutcher and Mila Kunis are planning a significant renovation of their Carpinteria beachfront property. The proposed changes include expanding the main residence and adding a swimming pool. They acquired the property in 2017 for $10.1 million and have seen its estimated value rise to about $17 million. The couple's plans involve the removal of a guest cottage to enhance the outdoor living space.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Ukraine drone attacks kill three, injure 14 in Russia’s Belgorod region
item.description: A drone strike carried out by Ukrainian forces hit Belgorod, leading to two confirmed deaths and injuring at least 13 people. Local officials highlighted significant destruction to housing, vehicles, and local infrastructure. Additionally, a nearby village reported another fatality and injuries stemming from the ongoing hostilities. These events underscore the ongoing violence escalating along the Russia-Ukraine border, and tensions continue to mount in the region.
item.dc:creator: Mahima Sharma

item.title: Trump claims US has secured Greenland, Venezuela in ‘greatest real estate deal’
item.description: Donald Trump asserted at a rally that the United States has secured Greenland and Venezuela as territories. His statements were made despite the lack of legal transfer of sovereignty over Greenland from Denmark. A recent memorandum of understanding focused on maritime cooperation, which does not include Greenland. Trump also announced a significant investment by Audi in Georgia, emphasizing job creation.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: Protests engulf Europe: People take to streets in France, Albania, Italy, Spain, Portugal
item.description: Thousands of people protested across Europe over the weekend, demanding action against rising living costs and government corruption. Demonstrations were reported in France, Italy, Albania, Spain, and Portugal, with varying degrees of violence. Clashes between protesters and police resulted in numerous arrests and injuries in several countries. Many demonstrators called for affordable housing, better education, and protection of public pensions.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: Man tries to sell home for $150,000, but cousin's four-year-old verbal deal holds up in court
item.description: A Kansas woman who claimed she agreed to buy her cousin's house and five acres of land in 2020 has won a property dispute after he received a $150,000 offer from another buyer. Tiffany Miller had taken over mortgage payments and made extensive repairs, but her cousin denied agreeing to sell. The Kansas Court of Appeals has upheld their verbal agreement.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Pakistan-Iran Trade Resumes: Key border crossing reopens after attack; LPG relief expected
item.description: Following a week-long closure due to security threats, Pakistan has reopened the Gabd-Rimdan border crossing with Iran. This pivotal reopening facilitates the flow of commercial goods that had been halted, leading to concerns regarding the availability of LPG and rising food and energy costs as winter neared. Enhanced security protocols are now in place to safeguard transport, bringing much-needed relief to local traders and transporters.
item.dc:creator: Mahima Sharma

item.title: Luxury Condo Deposits At Risk: buyers fight for refunds as foreclosure looms; branding future uncertain
item.description: Nilesh Undavia and other buyers are struggling to receive their deposits for unfinished luxury condos in Boca Raton. The Mandarin Oriental Residences project has faced significant construction delays, impacting buyers' financial investments. A $417.7 million foreclosure lawsuit complicates the situation for prospective homeowners seeking refunds. Penn-Florida Companies attributes delays to various challenges, including rising construction costs and supply-chain issues.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 6 children among 12 injured in shooting near Florida university stadium
item.description: A shooting occurred near a football stadium in Tallahassee during homecoming weekend at Florida A&M University. At least 12 individuals were injured, which included six children, and 11 had gunshot wounds. Authorities reported that three victims suffered serious injuries, with one critically injured and eight stable. The police chief indicated an altercation had preceded the shooting, but no arrests have been made.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey

item.title: Meet Leo Park, the 16-year-old South Korean artist whose drawings feature in a UK colouring book
item.description: South Korean teenager Leo Park, 16, who began sharing his architectural sketches on Instagram in 2019, has collaborated with British company Colour Your Streets on a colouring book featuring 30 UK cities. Known for his detailed freehand drawings, Park combines architecture, history and imagination in his work. The self-taught artist has also published other books and hopes to explore India's architectural heritage.
item.dc:creator: Anushree Sinha

item.title: US Midterm Elections: Trump blasts France’s immigration policy at rally; Macron pushes back
item.description: During a recent rally, Donald Trump voiced his disapproval of France's immigration policies, coinciding with widespread protests that saw nearly 1,000 arrests due to rising living costs. Clashes marked the demonstrations, prompting French President Emmanuel Macron to respond to foreign criticisms, while Netanyahu also commented on France’s approach to dealing with extremism. These events have escalated public outcry regarding education and economic conditions.

item.title: Scottish bagpiper Elliot Wilson raised £19,000 after an alleged attack in Edinburgh
item.description: Elliot Wilson, a 12-year-old bagpiper, raised £19,000 following an unfortunate incident while busking in Edinburgh. After being attacked by a group, he launched a crowdfunding campaign to cover damages to his kilt and case. The public response exceeded expectations, with over a thousand donations contributing to the total amount raised. Elliot decided to donate all funds to Preston Lodge pipe band to support its activities and expenses.
